data.narrative:
Lightelligence is a public-stage semiconductor company that has raised $310M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of three same-sector, same-stage public comparables in Chips & Semiconductors: Cerebras, Ouster, and Aeva Technologies.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Across the three public comps, the median valuation stands at $2.3B, with a range spanning $1.1B (Aeva Technologies) at the low end to $39.2B (Cerebras) at the high end. The wide dispersion reflects material differences in market positioning and investor confidence within the optical and specialized semiconductor segment. Given Lightelligence's capital intensity and stage maturity, the median offers a reasonable central anchor.

The triangulated valuation analysis supports a range of $1.9B to $2.6B, with a median of $2.3B. This narrow band reflects limited method diversity—only peer-median triangulation is applicable given available data—and carries corresponding model risk. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the peer set (particularly the $39.2B outlier in Cerebras, which may signal sector-wide valuation volatility) and the absence of revenue-multiple or DCF-based cross-checks. Additional margin-of-safety analysis would benefit from revenue traction, gross margin trajectory, and runway metrics.
